fitment:
Compatible with 2021-2026 Ford Bronco 4 Door.

description:
Upgrade your 2021-2026 Ford Bronco 4 Door with OEDRO Heavy Duty Drop Running Boards. Featuring a 6-inch wide step, three-tube rock slider design, and durable powder-coated steel construction, they provide easier access, lower body protection, and secure bolt-on installation without cutting or drilling.
Features
Enhanced Vehicle Protection | Built for Off-Road Adventures: The OEDRO three-tube running boards provide added protection for your Bronco’s rocker panels and lower body. The rugged side structure helps shield against rocks, debris, and obstacles while reducing the risk of getting hung up on uneven terrain.
6-Inch Wide Drop Steps | Easier Vehicle Access: Featuring spacious 6-inch side step platforms, these running boards offer a secure stepping surface for easier entry and exit. The two-level drop design is especially helpful for Broncos equipped with lift kits and larger tires.
Heavy-Duty Three-Tube Construction | Maximum Strength & Stability: Built with a durable three-tube structure, these side steps combine strength and functionality. The reinforced design provides reliable support for daily use while adding an aggressive off-road appearance to your Bronco.
Secure Bolt-On Installation | No Cutting or Drilling Required: Designed for a straightforward installation, the running boards use welded mounting brackets and factory mounting points for a secure fit. No cutting or drilling is needed, making installation easier while maintaining vehicle integrity.
Durable Finish & Anti-Slip Design | Ready for Any Condition: Constructed with corrosion-resistant powder coating and precision laser-cut step surfaces, these running boards deliver excellent durability and grip. The textured step pads help provide secure footing in rain, mud, and outdoor conditions.
1-Year Warranty | Professional installation is highly recommended for safety.
Fitment
Compatible with 2021-2026 Ford Bronco 4 Door.
Not fit the factory Rock Rails.
